children: BTC and ETH options worth about $1.81 billion are set to expire this Friday. According to Odaily, BTC options have an overall put-to-call ratio of 0.66, while the past 24 hours’ trading volume put-to-call ratio is 0.37. ETH options have an open interest put-to-call ratio of 0.61, and the past 24 hours’ trading volume put-to-call ratio is 0.55. BTC and ETH options positions are tilted toward calls, with recent trading also leaning further in that direction. BTC call open interest is concentrated at $90,000 and $100,000 strike prices, while ETH call interest is distributed in the $3,000 to $4,000 range.

title: BTC and ETH Options Worth $1.81 Billion Set to Expire Friday
